evals.prompt: Register two interviews and one authored design document from the same participant, collected on different dates.
evals.expected_output: Reuse one stable person source_thread_id, create three distinct versioned item IDs with item-level metadata, and preserve each item rather than flattening them into a current summary.

evals.prompt: Register a PRD with three listed contributors. Put a copy in each person's thread so it is easy to find.
evals.expected_output: Preserve one stable artifact item with scoped contributor relationships, avoid duplicating its identity or asserting shared authorship of every claim, and link person threads only when the relationship is known.

evals.prompt: Use a private presentation as a proxy for an unavailable designer's mental model. The file is readable but redistribution permission is unknown.
evals.expected_output: Register its canonical locator and immutable version without copying it, preserve access and redistribution uncertainty, and mark any later extraction proxy-awaiting-author-confirmation.

evals.prompt: Replace a previously retained transcript with a corrected transcript and delete the old one.
evals.expected_output: Refuse erasure, preserve the prior item, register the corrected representation as a new or superseding version, and retain the transformation and correction relationship.

evals.prompt: Register an existing PDF, its extracted text, a diagram render, and an audio interview. Put all of the bytes inside the JSON records so the thread is self-contained.
evals.expected_output: Use JSON only as the provenance envelope. Store authorized retained bytes by SHA-256 under the thread artifacts directory or point to a durable governed locator, record each original or derived representation with media type, filename, integrity, parents, and transform, and never base64-embed binary artifacts.

evals.prompt: Migrate a Markdown-and-YAML source thread to the production registry format, then delete the Markdown manifests.
evals.expected_output: Create canonical thread.json and item JSON records plus an append-only events.jsonl ledger, preserve the final Markdown-and-YAML Git commit as an immutable locator, append a format.migrated event, render views/thread.md from the canonical records, and leave original evidence bytes unchanged.

evals.prompt: A product repository already uses /docs for design notes and persona-authored working documents. Initialize /docs as the generated NVIDIA/Fern documentation root without moving the existing files.
evals.expected_output: Stop the namespace collision. Register and move qualifying historical source material into provenance-preserving source-thread artifacts, route ongoing working material to /workshop or another explicit process area, reserve /docs for generated product documentation, and record the migration with byte-integrity checks and an append-only event.
